mechanism: 同一工作台、面团、黄油、擀杖、刀具和烤盘持续锁定；面团依次经历包油、折叠、层压、切片、卷形、入盘、刷面和烤色等不可逆状态，终局掰开同一批成品证明层次与拉丝。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One adult hand identity, one work surface, one dough, one fat layer, one rolling tool and one tray persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult hand identity, one work surface, one dough, one fat layer, one rolling tool and one tray persist."

invariants.rule: Each beat performs one irreversible food-state operation and inherits visible material traces from the prior state.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each beat performs one irreversible food-state operation and inherits visible material traces from the prior state."

invariants.rule: Rolling, folding and cutting preserve the same slab and produce a countable set of pieces.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Rolling, folding and cutting preserve the same slab and produce a countable set of pieces."

invariants.rule: The oven transition returns the same tray and positions with a plausible baked-state change.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The oven transition returns the same tray and positions with a plausible baked-state change."

invariants.rule: The terminal split uses one item from the verified batch and exposes internal layers without substitution.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal split uses one item from the verified batch and exposes internal layers without substitution."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
